components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            present it is used to compose the owner's salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for backward
            compatibility; when structured address fields are supplied they take
            precedence. On read it is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended
            when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied
            (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat address; it is normalized on create
            (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations
            expanded) and the composed address is derived from it.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When
            present it is normalized and appended to the composed address after a single
            space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            afterwards; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows the owner to be created even if another owner
            already belongs to the same household (i.e. shares the same last name and
            postcode); the owner is then created as a declared household member and is
            not flagged as a possible duplicate. When false or omitted, such a create is
            rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            validated only when present, stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's optional date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When present it
            is used to derive the owner's ageBand relative to the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as 'title lastName' when a title
                is present, or just the lastName when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes separated by
                spaces. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier formatted as
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code derived from the
                owner's postcode, the 2-digit fiscal year (the last two digits of
                the fiscal year ending, derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate; the fiscal year starts on 1 July), the 8
                upper-cased hex characters of the SHA-256 of
                (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and a single Luhn check digit
                computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the household, the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 of the owner's normalized last name and
                postcode. Owners with the same last name (compared case-insensitively
                with surrounding whitespace trimmed) and postcode are automatically
                assigned the same value.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1b9c4d5e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived duplicate-detection key, formatted as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the email segment is
                empty when the owner has no email. Two owners are considered
                duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3f2a1b9c4d5e'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, computed on creation: starting at 0,
                adding 2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 when the
                owner belongs to a household of 3 or more members, and 3 when tenure
                spans at least one elapsed fiscal year since the registrationDate (the
                fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4
                for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's registration day at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, indicating the
                city is approaching its capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate relative to the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted as 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is labelled by the last two digits of the calendar year
                in which it ends, so a registration on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year ending the following calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner, formatted as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, an existing owner
                shared this owner's lastName and postcode but had a different
                telephone (a soft match that is not a hard duplicate), otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on lastName and
                postcode at creation time, or absent when there was no such match.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate
                (possibleDuplicate is true), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (it shares its registrable base name with a
                known disposable domain, so it either is a subdomain of one or the
                same base under a different TLD), or the owner's city is over its
                soft capacity (capacityWarning is true, i.e. the city already held
                40 or more owners). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record. Soft-deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

        under version 1 is reproduced.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-

            '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the version-2 region code (the
            postcode-derived region with the fixed 'V2' tag appended, e.g.
            'NSWV2'), FY is the 2-digit fiscal year (the last two digits of the
            fiscal year ending, derived from the business-day-adjusted
            registrationDate; the fiscal year starts on 1 July), HASH8 is the 8
            upper-cased hex characters of the SHA-256 of
            (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and CHK is a single Luhn check
            digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2261A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable shared identifier for the household, the first 12 hex
            characters of the SHA-256 of the owner's normalized last name,
            postcode and the fixed 'V2' version tag. Owners with the same last
            name (compared case-insensitively with surrounding whitespace
            trimmed) and postcode are automatically assigned the same value.
          type: string
          example: '3f2a1b9c4d5e'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The derived duplicate-detection key: the lower-case hex SHA-256 of
            'normalizedTelephone|email|soundex(lastName)|V2', with an empty
            segment for an absent telephone or email. Two owners are considered
            duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
          type: string
          example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90'
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - memberId
        - householdId
        - identityKey
